Blueface, Born Johnathan Jamall Porter On January 20, 1997, Is A Los Angeles Rapper Who Rose To Fame In 2018 With His Viral Hit Song “Thotiana.” Known For His Unique Offbeat Flow, Distinctive Voice, And West Coast Sound, Blueface Quickly Became One Of The Most Recognizable Personalities In LA’s Rap Scene. His Breakthrough Record Eventually Received A Remix Featuring Cardi B And YG, Helping Push Him Into Mainstream Success.

Beyond Music, Blueface Has Built A Massive Following Through Social Media, Reality Television, And Livestreaming. His Highly Publicized Relationships With Jaidyn Alexis And Chrisean Rock Have Also Kept Him In The Headlines. Despite Various Controversies And Legal Troubles Throughout His Career, Blueface Continues To Draw Attention Through His Music, Family Life, And Viral Internet Moments.

Cr*p Mac, Born Trevor Hurd On February 20, 1993, Is A Los Angeles Rapper, Social Media Personality, And Viral Internet Figure Known For His Outspoken Personality, Distinctive Slang, And Strong Ties To South Central LA. He Rose To Fame Through Viral Interviews With Platforms Like No Jumper And His Popular Catchphrases, Including “Everything Gonna C Alright” And “Keep It 55th Street.” His Music Includes Songs Like “Opp Goblin,” “No Fair Ones,” And “55th Street.” VladTV +1

Cr*p Mac Has Also Made Headlines For His Legal Troubles, Including A Federal Case That Resulted In A 33-Month Prison Sentence. Following His Release In 2026, He Returned To Social Media, Interviews, And Music. He Has Also Had A Complicated History With Blueface, As The Two LA Personalities Previously Exchanged Public Criticism Before Later Appearing To Be On Better Terms. Both Have Become Recognizable Figures In West Coast Internet Culture. Complex +2
